message.content:
A vertical editorial illustration features a caricature of a man in a light blue shirt and dark trousers, leaning forward as he carries a tall, leaning stack of roughly twenty chairs on his back. The chairs, made of grey metal frames with variously colored seats—red, orange, yellow, green, and blue—are stacked haphazardly and extend toward the top-right corner. Seated atop the highest chair is the lower half of another figure wearing dark pants and black shoes.

The masthead displays the large red word "TEMPO" across the top. To the left, bold black text reads "KABINET GEMOY-GEMOY," followed by a paragraph of smaller Indonesian text and "H. 26." Other headlines include "Kejanggalan IPO Perusahaan Prajogo Pangestu H. 84" and "Perkara Korupsi Sahbirin Noor H. 74." The bottom left corner contains the date "21-27 OKTOBER 2024," a price, website, and a barcode with the ISSN "0126-4273." The background is a plain white space, casting a soft shadow beneath the man's feet.
